OpenXR SDK headers and Android ARM64 loader from Khronos OpenXR-SDK release 1.1.54.

The loader was built for Android in the project's archived Quest build. Headers
come from the matching local OpenXR-SDK checkout. The Apache-2.0 license is in
LICENSE. Upstream source is https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK/tree/release-1.1.54.
